name: event-log
description: Every event that crosses Claude Code in a session, in the order it happened, whoever raised it (you, the model, the engine, settings hooks, plugins): full payloads to ~/.claude/event-log/<session>/NNNN.jsonl, a peek per event in a live pane. UI events and plugins' read-only calls are only counted; /eventlog toggles it, /eventlog <you|claude|engine|hook|plugin|all> filters by who.

maxMB.title: Log size cap (MB)
maxMB.description: Per session: past it the log stops writing to disk, and the pane says so
